# Cafe De Siam

> Thai Restaurant in Tampa, Florida. Fresh spring rolls, red curry, pad Thai and crispy duck, served unhurried on West Hillsborough Avenue. The owner stops by your table to check on you.

- Phone: (813) 855-1108
- Address: 11242 W Hillsborough Ave, Tampa, FL 33635
- Areas: Tampa, Temple Terrace, Carrollwood, Town 'n' Country
- Offers: Noodles; Starters; Lunch specials
- Rating: 4.6 from 276 Google reviews
